abstract: The cultivation of cover crops is one of the new Eco‐scheme practices introduced in Sweden. This study examines how the design of policy attributes of these schemes influences farmers' willingness to grow cover crops on arable land, with particular focus on the potential impact of a glyphosate ban. A discrete choice experiment was conducted with Swedish crop farmers ( N = 875), considering three policy attributes (commitment duration, maximum allowable percentage of mixed legume plants, and subsidy payment levels), two alternatives (permission to sell or utilize cover crop biomass versus restrictions), and one treatment condition (glyphosate ban). A Latent Class Logit Model was employed to explore heterogeneity in farmers' willingness to grow cover crops. The analysis identified three distinct farmer groups: 29% are unlikely to grow cover crops regardless of policy attribute design, 41% are predisposed to adoption irrespective of policy attributes, and 30% are influenced by subsidy payment scheme design. For the latter group, a glyphosate ban should reduce their willingness to grow cover crops. These findings offer valuable insights for enhancing flexibility in Eco‐scheme management prescriptions for promoting greater farmer participation, such as easing the restriction on the maximum number of legume plants in cover crops and permitting farmers to sell or utilize cover crops.
abstract_zh: 覆盖作物的种植是瑞典引入的新生态计划实践之一。本研究探讨了这些计划政策属性的设计如何影响农民在耕地上种植覆盖作物的意愿，特别关注草甘膦禁令的潜在影响。我们与瑞典农作物种植者（N=875）进行了一项离散选择实验，考虑了三个政策属性（承诺期限、混合豆科植物最大允许比例及补贴支付水平）、两个备选方案（允许出售或利用覆盖作物生物质与限制措施）以及一个处理条件（草甘膦禁令）。采用潜在类别Logit模型来探究农民种植覆盖作物意愿的异质性。分析识别出三个不同的农民群体：29%的农民无论政策属性设计如何都不太可能种植覆盖作物，41%的农民无论政策属性如何都倾向于采纳，而30%的农民则受补贴支付方案设计的影响。对于后者群体，草甘膦禁令应会降低他们种植覆盖作物的意愿。这些发现为增强生态计划管理规定的灵活性以促进更多农民参与提供了宝贵见解，例如放宽覆盖作物中豆科植物最大数量的限制，并允许农民出售或利用覆盖作物。
title: Ban Glyphosate—Does It Affect the Swedish Farmers' Willingness to Grow Cover Crops?
title_zh: 禁用草甘膦——是否影响瑞典农民种植覆盖作物的意愿？

abstract: Increased vertical integration and coordination are defining features of transforming and modernizing agricultural value chains in low- and middle-income countries, with important implications for market efficiency and farm-level transformation. However, research documenting these processes in modernizing domestic value chains is limited, and tends to focus on foreign direct investment and high-value food products. We study the rice value chain – the most important staple in Southeast Asia – in Myanmar and use unique data from domestic rice mills and farmers to analyze millers’ expansion into other businesses and services. We show that both modern and traditional mills serve as key nodes in local rice value chains, fulfilling diverse roles beyond processing at both the farm and post-farm levels and highlighting a co-development of modern processing and vertical integration. Yet, statistical tests that control for mill and farmer characteristics, respectively, show that modern mills are more engaged in vertical integration and coordination, particularly in post-farm value chain segments, highlighting the co-development of modern processing and business expansion. Consistent with this pattern in the miller data, farmers using a modern mill are more likely to receive complementary services – especially post-farm – and to adopt modern production practices more broadly. However, this expansion is uneven, reaching large farms more frequently than small and medium farms.
abstract_zh: 在中低收入国家，农业价值链的转型与现代化进程中，纵向整合与协调的增强是显著特征，这对市场效率和农场层面转型具有重要影响。然而，关于国内价值链现代化进程中这些过程的文献研究有限，且往往聚焦于外国直接投资和高价值食品。我们以缅甸稻米价值链——东南亚最重要的主食——为研究对象，利用国内稻米加工厂和农户的独特数据，分析加工厂向其他业务和服务的扩张。研究表明，现代和传统加工厂均作为当地稻米价值链的关键节点，在农场和农场后层面发挥超越加工环节的多元作用，凸显了现代加工与纵向整合的协同发展。然而，分别控制加工厂和农户特征的统计检验显示，现代加工厂在纵向整合与协调方面参与度更高，尤其在农场后价值链环节，这进一步印证了现代加工与业务扩张的协同发展。与加工厂数据中的这一模式一致，使用现代加工厂的农户更有可能获得补充性服务（尤其是农场后服务），并更广泛地采用现代生产实践。然而，这种扩张并不均衡，大型农场比中小型农场更频繁地受益。
title: Vertical integration and the modernization of staple food value chains: Evidence from Myanmar’s rice sector
title_zh: 纵向一体化与主食价值链现代化：来自缅甸稻米部门的证据

abstract: We investigate the macroeconomic effects of commodity price uncertainty by explicitly accounting for comovement across commodity markets. Using quarterly realized volatilities of major agricultural, metals, and energy commodity prices, we estimate a hierarchical dynamic factor model that decomposes uncertainty into a global component, common to all commodities, and group-specific components capturing sectoral uncertainty. The estimated uncertainty factors are then embedded into country-specific Structural VAR models to assess the dynamic macroeconomic responses to uncertainty shocks through impulse response functions. We focus in particular on business investment and exports across a panel of advanced and emerging economies. Our results show that a global commodity price uncertainty shock generates sizable and persistent recessionary effects on investment and trade worldwide. Benchmark comparisons indicate that this global commodity uncertainty shock produces larger and more persistent macroeconomic contractions than standard uncertainty measures. Importantly, we show that, once global uncertainty is accounted for, commodity-specific uncertainty shocks exhibit differentiated effects. Increases in agricultural and metals price uncertainty lead to contractionary outcomes, whereas energy-specific uncertainty shocks generate positive short-run responses in investment and exports. These findings provide new empirical evidence that oil price uncertainty can be expansionary when it reflects sector-specific dynamics rather than global demand uncertainty. Overall, our framework offers a novel way to disentangle “bad” and “good” commodity price uncertainty.
abstract_zh: 我们通过明确考虑大宗商品市场间的联动性，研究大宗商品价格不确定性的宏观经济效应。利用主要农产品、金属和能源大宗商品价格的季度已实现波动率，我们估计了一个层级动态因子模型，将不确定性分解为所有大宗商品共有的全球成分，以及捕捉部门性不确定性的组别特定成分。随后，将估计出的不确定性因子嵌入到国家特定的结构向量自回归模型中，通过脉冲响应函数评估不确定性冲击的动态宏观经济反应。我们特别关注一组发达经济体和新兴经济体中企业投资与出口的表现。结果显示，全球大宗商品价格不确定性冲击在全球范围内对投资和贸易产生了显著且持久的衰退效应。基准比较表明，这种全球大宗商品不确定性冲击比标准不确定性度量引发了更大且更持久的宏观经济收缩。重要的是，我们表明，一旦考虑全球不确定性，大宗商品特定不确定性冲击会表现出差异化效应。农产品和金属价格不确定性的上升导致收缩性结果，而能源特定不确定性冲击则在短期内对投资和出口产生正向反应。这些发现提供了新的经验证据，表明当油价不确定性反映的是部门特定动态而非全球需求不确定性时，其可能具有扩张性。总体而言，我们的框架提供了一种新颖的方法来区分“坏”与“好”的大宗商品价格不确定性。
title: Commodity price uncertainty comovement: Does it matter for global economic growth?
title_zh: 大宗商品价格不确定性的联动性：对全球经济增长重要吗？

journal: Journal of Financial and Quantitative Analysis
title: The Sensitivity of Cash Saving to the Cost of Capital

abstract: The literature on the relationship between extreme heat and mental health in low- and middle-income countries has primarily focused on long-term and indirect channels, such as harvest failures and their impacts on mental health. In contrast, this study assesses the direct, short-term effects of heat stress on mental health and explores potential underlying physiological mechanisms. Moreover, by using a heat stress measure that accounts for non-linear interactions between heat and relative humidity (wet bulb temperature) and comparing it with conventional temperature measures (dry bulb temperature), I show that neglecting this interaction may underestimate the true effect. I combine data on self-reported depression and anxiety symptoms from four waves of the Indian WHO-SAGE survey with high-resolution climate data, exploiting quasi-random variation in heat exposure driven by the timing and location of survey implementation. The results show that exposure to extreme heat stress (wet bulb temperature) increases the reporting of depressive symptoms, but not of anxiety symptoms. The effects are consistently smaller and insignificant when dry bulb temperature is used together with humidity as linear control variable. The evidence points to heat stress exposure during agricultural work, increased cognitive difficulties, and sleeping disturbances as pathways linking heat stress and mental health among rural populations, while urban populations are not affected. Finally, the study shows that access to the District Mental Health Program plays a protective role, mitigating the negative impact of heat stress on mental health. These results underscore the need to integrate mental health into climate impact assessments and adaptation policies.
abstract_zh: 关于极端高温与中低收入国家心理健康之间关系的文献，主要聚焦于长期和间接渠道，如农作物歉收及其对心理健康的影响。相比之下，本研究评估了热应激对心理健康的直接短期效应，并探讨了潜在的生理机制。此外，通过采用考虑热与相对湿度非线性相互作用的热应激指标（湿球温度），并将其与传统温度指标（干球温度）进行比较，我表明忽视这种相互作用可能会低估真实效应。我将印度WHO-SAGE调查四轮中自我报告的抑郁和焦虑症状数据与高分辨率气候数据相结合，利用调查实施时间和地点所驱动的热暴露的准随机变化。结果显示，暴露于极端热应激（湿球温度）会增加抑郁症状的报告，但对焦虑症状无显著影响。当使用干球温度并同时将湿度作为线性控制变量时，效应始终较小且不显著。证据表明，农业劳动中的热应激暴露、认知困难增加以及睡眠障碍是连接热应激与农村人口心理健康之间的途径，而城市人口则未受影响。最后，研究表明，获得地区心理健康项目具有保护作用，能够减轻热应激对心理健康的负面影响。这些结果强调了将心理健康纳入气候影响评估和适应政策的必要性。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: The mental health toll of heat stress in India
title_zh: 印度热应激对心理健康的损害

abstract: The maturity premium, a newly proposed anomaly, characterizes higher returns of stocks adopting more long-term debt. Motivated by the stylized facts of declines in the use and dispersion in long-term debt for the U.S. companies, we hypothesize that the maturity premium has attenuated in recent periods. Applying Bai and Perron’s (1998) structural-change test, we detect one structural break at June 2000. The abnormal maturity premium is significant before this date but becomes insignificant afterwards. Our results are robust to different factor models and the concentration of the smallest firms.
abstract_zh: 期限溢价，作为一种新提出的异象，描述了采用更多长期债务的股票获得更高回报的现象。鉴于美国公司长期债务使用减少及其分布分散化的典型事实，我们假设期限溢价在近期已有所减弱。运用Bai和Perron（1998）的结构变化检验，我们检测到2000年6月存在一个结构断点。在此日期之前，异常期限溢价显著，而之后则不再显著。我们的结果在不同因子模型及最小公司集中度下均保持稳健。
title: Has the maturity premium attenuated over time?
title_zh: 期限溢价是否随时间衰减？

abstract: This paper employs a sequential learning framework to extend the static industrial organisation literature regarding optimal capacity choice and timing for incumbents and potential entrants to a dynamic environment with heterogeneous products in which uncertainty over future demand changes over time. The incumbent is uncertain about the quality of the entrant’s product and receives imperfect information signals at random points in time. Based on these signals, the incumbent updates his belief about the entrant’s product in a Bayesian fashion. Once adequately convinced about its true quality, he stops learning and makes a capacity choice according to his conviction. Existing models on capacity choice and timing in an incumbent-entrant context have not accounted for incomplete information and sequential learning in their analyses. As such, there are several novel implications that arise from the modeling framework, as well as new rationales for incumbent inertia and what this suggests in terms of over- and under-investment in capacity relative to the welfare-maximising socially optimal level.
abstract_zh: 本文采用序贯学习框架，将关于在位者与潜在进入者最优产能选择及时机的静态产业组织文献，扩展至一个产品具有异质性且未来需求不确定性随时间变化的动态环境中。在位者对于进入者产品的质量存在不确定性，并在随机时间点接收到不完美的信息信号。基于这些信号，在位者以贝叶斯方式更新其对进入者产品的信念。一旦充分确信其真实质量，他便停止学习，并根据其信念做出产能选择。现有关于在位者-进入者情境下产能选择与时机选择的模型，在分析中未考虑不完全信息与序贯学习。因此，该建模框架产生了若干新颖的推论，并为在位者惰性提供了新的解释，同时揭示了相对于福利最大化的社会最优水平，产能过度投资与投资不足的潜在原因。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: A dynamic model of capital investment with uncertain demand and Bayesian learning
title_zh: 需求不确定与贝叶斯学习下的资本投资动态模型
